skript.thema: Gemini app for YouTube video questions and clip uploads

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: You just knocked grape juice onto your wool rug.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: black-haired presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses stares in horror at a dark purple stain spreading on a cream wool rug, medium close-up, warm evening lamp light, calm space above and below.

teile.name: Promise
teile.text: Gemini can find the fix. One setting kills it.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter kneels by the stained rug, holds his phone from behind toward the viewer, raised eyebrow and sly half smile, medium shot, soft evening light, empty top and bottom.

teile.name: Ask about YouTube
teile.text: Ask for rug-cleaning videos, then summarize the first.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter types with his thumbs, over-the-shoulder close shot, rug stain visible on the floor below, soft evening light, phone seen only from behind, no readable screen.

teile.name: Engagement
teile.text: Be sure to like, share and save this video.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter gives a confident thumbs up with a grin, kneeling beside the grape-stained rug in a cozy living room, medium shot, warm lamp light, calm space above.

teile.name: The setting
teile.text: Which setting? Activity. Off means no feature.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter flicks a wall switch down with a wince, dim apartment hallway, medium shot, cool blue light fading, dramatic shadows, no text.

teile.name: Upload a clip
teile.text: Uploaded clips: 5 minutes total, 1 hour with upgrade.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter on a couch holds up his phone from behind and swipes with a thumb, cyan glow on his face, close shot, night apartment, no readable interface.

teile.name: Resolution
teile.text: The problem remains your wool rug.
teile.szene: Painted open-world poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter shrugs with a wry grin, then kneels with a cloth over the grape stain on the wool rug, medium shot, warm morning light, determined mood.

regeln: Within each spoken phase use multiple distinct relevant shots, roughly 3-5 seconds each for Shorts; long videos can allow purposeful longer demonstrations. Preserve continuous narration and accurate subtitle timing.
A zoom, crop, subtitle change or decorative background does not count as a new motif. Never fill missing images with candles, unrelated stock or background-only frames.
Show the main image prominently; avoid tiny repeated photos in a mostly empty vertical frame. Preserve genuine evidence and important image details.
For AI Tools Explained identify the exact tool briefly, then show genuine interface views and different source-supported examples. Never present stock or an illustration as a real tool result.
Use original urban painted open-world-game poster styling for fictional scenes and presenters; no copied game characters. Match narrated action and era.

Clear speech and readable captions alone do not make a professional video. Inspect useful motif changes and narration-image alignment over the entire video. Missing main imagery is a substantial defect.
Include mandatory spoken like, share and save calls at the correct format-specific positions. Do not replace this requirement with a different CTA.

AI Tools Explained is for viewers with a practical task. Do not read parameter counts, architecture names, pipeline tags, context lengths or benchmark claims as a substitute for useful explanation. Explain the human task, the source-supported action and a concrete limit. A generic trending-tools question failed story review twice; prefer a specific visual workflow.

The user confirmed original presenter references on 2026-10-05: Business Origin Stories uses the blue-eyed man with a fedora, grey suit, dark tie and gold pocket watch; AI Tools Explained uses the black-haired man with black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses. Preserve identity and typical clothing, vary action and setting.

Introduce the correct presenter at the opening and bring that same presenter back during the video in useful actions. Do not confine the figure to the ending. Do not replace original channel figures with different fictional people; anonymous period workers remain clearly illustrative supporting people, never a real-founder likeness.

Prefer vivid original painted open-world-game scenes to long holds on lifeless documentary photos. Preserve factual accuracy and show authentic tool examples briefly as evidence. Camera moves alone are not new motifs or full character animation.

The user confirmed on 2026-10-05 that both new delivered videos are much better than before. Preserve the original painted world, recurring channel identity, matching main imagery, music and useful scene changes. The long-term quality target remains 10/10; the user did not give these videos a numeric score. Do not replace their actual AI scores or the existing 7/10 delivery threshold with the aspirational target.

belege.name: Gemini Apps Help: Find & ask about YouTube content
belege.text:
Official Gemini Apps Help page (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16622858?hl=en), fetched 2026-11-19.
PAGE TEXT:
Find & ask about YouTube content in Gemini Apps You can discover YouTube videos and get answers about them in Gemini Apps. Gemini uses public information from YouTube to help you: Find videos, playlists, and channels on a specific topic Understand the content of a video And more What you need Be signed in to the Gemini app. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps . Keep Activity on. This feature isn’t available when this setting is off. Important: For now, this feature isn’t available in Live chats. This feature isn’t available in Gemini in Google Messages. Find & ask about content on YouTube You can ask Gemini to search for and tell you about YouTube videos, playlists, and channels. On your phone or tablet, open the Gemini mobile app or go to gemini.google.com . Ask Gemini to find a video and then ask about it. Try this example prompt: Find videos of how to quickly get grape juice out of a wool rug. Summarize the first video. What Gemini Apps can’t do with YouTube For now, the following actions aren’t supported in Gemini Apps when it’s connected to YouTube: Show a comprehensive list of videos from your watch history, liked videos, saved playlists, subscribed channels. Take actions that impact your YouTube experience, like saving a video to a playlist or adding a comment on a video. About your data & other Google services Learn more about how your data is used and how Gemini Apps get help from Google services in the Gemini Apps Privacy Notice . belege.name: Gemini Apps Help: Attach & analyze files
belege.text:
Official Gemini Apps Help page (https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/14903178?hl=en), fetched 2026-11-19.
PAGE TEXT:
Attach & analyze files in Gemini Apps You can attach documents, spreadsheets, notebooks, photos, videos, and more to Gemini Apps to get answers, summaries, and insights about your content. What you need If you’re signed in to a work or school Google Account: To attach files from Google Drive, access to apps in Gemini must be enabled by your organization’s Workspace administrator.  Learn about administrators . Learn more about using Gemini Apps with a work or school account or how to enable access to apps in Gemini Apps . To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps . Tip: To get higher limits for this feature, like the ability to attach more files or ask Gemini Apps to reference attached files in more chats, you can upgrade to a Google AI plan. Learn more about limits and  how to upgrade . Attach files & code In the Gemini web app On your computer, go to gemini.google.com . In the text box at the bottom, enter your question or prompt. Click Add files . To attach a supported file from your device: click Upload Files . To add a code folder: click More Uploads Import Code Upload folder . To add a GitHub repository: More Uploads Import Code and enter the GitHub repository or branch URL. Learn more about adding GitHub repositories . To add a supported file from your Google Drive: click Add from Drive . To add files from your Drive, you need to have History on and connect Google Workspace to Gemini Apps. If it’s not connected, you'll get the option to connect it. Learn about your Gemini Apps and Google Workspace data . To add a notebook: click More Uploads Notebooks . Click Submit . Tips: You can add up to 10 (subject to availability) of any kind of supported file in the same prompt, such as documents, images, or videos. If you get an error that Gemini failed to analyze your file correctly, re-attach it. In Gemini in Chrome Open Chrome and navigate to a page you want to analyze or summarize. At the top of your browser, click Gemini in Chrome . At the bottom of the text box, enter your question or prompt. Click Add files . To upload a supported file from your device : click Files . You can click, drag, and drop images from a web page.  You can copy and paste images from a webpage. Click Submit . File types & attachment limits Gemini Apps support most file types. Up to 10 files (subject to availability) can be attacheded in the same prompt. When uploading a folder, each file inside will count towards this limit. Each video can be up to 2 GB. All other supported file types can be up to 100 MB. Total video length can be up to 5 minutes. Upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra to extend total attachment length to 1 hour. Total audio length can be up to 10 minutes. Upgrade to Google AI Pro or Google AI Ultra to extend total attachment length to 3 hours. One code folder, or one GitHub repository, with up to 5,000 files and a maximum size of 100 MB, can be added to a chat. Learn more about adding GitHub rep
